title: DatasetStructureModel
description: Describes how a scientific dataset is laid out: where its files live, which entity hierarchy the folder and file structure encodes, and how metadata is read out of path components. The core, which readers implement, is the filesystem source type and the extraction methods substring, regex, template, fixed and function. Blocks marked DRAFT are outside the core and readers may reject them.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the DatasetStructureModel schema this document conforms to, using semantic versioning.

entityTypes.description: Semantic entity types present in the dataset (e.g. subject, session). Every entity type referenced by an entityLayout level or a metadata definition must be declared here.

entityRelationships.description: Semantic relationships between entity types, independent of physical storage layout.

metadataDefinitions.description: Global dictionary of metadata fields, keyed by field identifier. Each field belongs to one entity type. All references to metadata (identifierRef, metadataRef, template tokens) point to keys in this object; no field is defined anywhere else.

dataLocations.description: One entry per logical collection of data (raw, processed, ...). Each has its own root paths, hierarchy and extraction rules.

name.description: Name of the entity type (e.g. 'subject', 'session'). Referenced by entityLayout levels and by metadataDefinitions.ofEntity.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the primary entity type of the dataset (typically the top-level unit, such as subject or participant).

identifierRef.description: Key in metadataDefinitions whose extracted value identifies an instance of this entity type. Two instances found in different data locations are the same real-world entity when this value is equal and their entity-typed ancestors match. Extraction rules for this field MUST produce identical values for the same entity in every location; use normalize where naming conventions differ. Exactly one of identifierRef and identifierRefs is required.

identifierRefs.description: Composite identity key: all listed fields must be equal for two instances to be the same entity. Every listed field must belong to this entity type (ofEntity); ancestor identity is implicit and must not be listed. Exactly one of identifierRef and identifierRefs is required.

name.description: Human-readable name of the metadata field.

title.description: User-facing display name (e.g. 'Subject ID'). When absent, name is used.

dataType.description: Type of the extracted value. Readers parse date, time and datetime values using the extraction rule's valueFormat.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for numeric fields, ideally UCUM-compatible (e.g. 'um', 'Hz', 's'). Omit for dimensionless quantities.

defaultValue.description: Value to use when the field cannot be extracted.

ofEntity.description: Name of the entity type this field belongs to (must match a name in entityTypes).

validation.description: Constraints on the extracted value. The pattern is also used to derive matchPattern from a pathComponentTemplate token.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match (portable subset).

preferences.description: Instance-level context: which computing environment is active and which data location is the default. Optional in the shared config. A reader that finds a sibling file named '<config basename>.local.json' takes the preferences from that file in preference to these, so that per-machine settings stay out of a config that is shared or version-controlled.

defaultDataLocationIdentifier.description: Identifier of the data location to use when a tool does not specify one.

environmentIdentifier.description: Identifier of the current computing environment (e.g. 'windows-lab', 'mac-analysis'). Selects the rootStoragePath whose environment matches.

customProperties.description: Free-form key-value pairs for tool-specific or domain-specific data the schema does not model (e.g. a UI's example path, an instrument name). Values may be any JSON type. Readers preserve but do not interpret them.

identifier.description: Unique identifier of this data location within the config. Used in cross-references (derivedFrom, preferences.defaultDataLocationIdentifier) and in entity records.

uuid.description: Optional stable identifier for tools that persist references to this location outside the config. Unlike identifier, a uuid never changes once assigned.

description.description: Purpose, contents or provenance of this location.

dataCategory.description: Role of this location in the data lifecycle. Does not imply access permission; see access.

access.description: Whether tools may create folders and write files in this location. Independent of dataCategory: category is the location's role, access is permission. Defaults to read because a description of existing data does not grant write access.

sourceType.description: Kind of source. 'filesystem' is the core and requires filesystemSource. 'spreadsheet', 'database' and 'api' are DRAFT: they require their source block and entityType, and readers may reject them.

entityType.description: DRAFT: for non-filesystem sources, the entity type whose records this source provides. Not used for filesystem sources (the entityLayout declares entity types).

derivedFrom.description: Identifiers of the data locations this location's data was produced from. Provenance only; it does not describe how. Tools also use it to find the source entities whose metadata fills pathComponentTemplate tokens when generating output paths.

tags.description: Free-form tags for categorisation, filtering or search.

filesystemSource.description: A data location whose entities are discovered by walking a folder tree from a root path.

rootStoragePaths.description: Root of the tree, one entry per computing environment (and per mirror within an environment, ordered by priority).

entityLayout.description: Ordered levels of the hierarchy below the root, outermost first. Each level maps a folder depth (or, for the last level, files in a folder) to an entity type or marks it as structural.

metadataMapping.description: How the globally defined metadata fields are extracted from path components in this location. One entry per field; the same field may be extracted differently in other locations.

metadataRef.description: Key in metadataDefinitions that this rule populates.

pathTemplate.description: Informational: the full path structure with placeholders, e.g. '{rootPath}/{subject_id}/{session_id}'. The authoritative structure is entityLayout.

additionalFolders.description: Folder names that may exist inside an entity folder at the innermost level but are not entities (e.g. 'logs', 'temp').

identifier.description: Unique identifier of this root path within the data location. Referenced from entity records.

uuid.description: Optional stable identifier for tools that persist references to this root path. Never changes once assigned.

path.description: Absolute file system path of the root on this environment.

volumeName.description: Name of the disk or volume the path is on. Readers may use it to re-resolve the root when the mount point or drive letter has changed.

environment.description: Computing environment this path is valid for; matched against preferences.environmentIdentifier. Omit when the config is used on one environment only.

priority.description: Selection order when several root paths match the current environment; lower is preferred.

name.description: Name of this level, unique within the entityLayout. Extraction rules reference levels by this name.

entityType.description: Entity type represented by entries at this level (must match an entityTypes name). Omit for a structural level: a folder that is part of the path but is not an entity, such as a date folder or a fixed 'processed' folder. Structural levels are skipped when building entity identity.

fileSystemType.description: Whether entries at this level are folders or files. At a file level, entity instances are keyed by the entity type's identity extracted from the file name: every file whose extracted identity is equal belongs to the same entity, and the entity resolves to that set of files plus their parent folder. Use filePatterns to declare which files belong to an entity. A file level must be the last level.

pathComponentTemplate.description: How an entry name is composed from metadata fields, e.g. 'session-{session_id}'. Tokens in braces reference keys in metadataDefinitions. Used to generate names when writing to a readwrite location, and to derive matchPattern when that is absent: each {token} matches the referenced definition's validation.pattern if it has one, else [^/\\]+, and the result is anchored with ^ and $.

matchPattern.description: Regular expression (portable subset) an entry name must match to count as an entry at this level. Required for a variable level unless pathComponentTemplate is present.

excludePatterns.description: Regular expressions for entry names to skip at this level, applied before matchPattern (e.g. '^\\..*', '^temp$').

isRequired.description: Whether this level must exist. A location need not contain every ancestor level of its entities: a processed location may hold session folders directly, with subject identity extracted from the session name.

isVariable.description: true when entry names vary per entity (the usual case); false for a single fixed folder name given in fixedName.

fixedName.description: The folder name when isVariable is false (e.g. 'processed').

filePatterns.description: Kinds of files that belong to an entity at this level. For a folder level: files inside the entity folder. For a file level: files in the parent folder that belong to the entity.

fileGroupingPattern.description: One kind of file belonging to an entity at a given level.

name.description: Optional name of this file kind, unique within the level. Readers report matched files under this name in entity records.

pattern.description: Regular expression (portable subset) matched against file names. May contain {token} references to metadata fields of the entity, e.g. '^{session_id}_raw\\.tif$'; each token is replaced by the regex-escaped value for the entity being resolved before matching, so membership is exact rather than by substring. Braces containing only digits and commas are regex quantifiers, not tokens.

isRequired.description: Whether at least one matching file must exist for the entity to be complete.

cardinality.description: Whether exactly one file ('one') or any number of files ('many', e.g. a numbered series) is expected to match per entity.

metadataExtraction.description: How to obtain a metadata value for an entity from its path. A rule is evaluated per entity instance; entityLayoutLevel selects which component of the instance's path it reads.

method.description: substring: a slice of the path component. regex: the first capture group of pattern, or the whole match. template: compose the value from other extracted fields. fixed: a constant. function: call a reader-registered extractor. sidecar (DRAFT): read the value from a file inside the entity folder.

pattern.description: substring: a Python-style slice 'start:stop' of the path component: 0-based, half-open, either bound may be omitted, negative indices count from the end, no step (e.g. '0:8', '9:', ':-4'). At a file level the component is the file name including its extension. regex: the expression; the value is the first capture group, or the whole match when there is none. template: a string with {token} references to other metadata fields of the same entity or its ancestors, e.g. '{session_date}_{subject_id}'; readers resolve the order of evaluation and reject cycles.

valueFormat.description: For date, time and datetime fields: the pattern the extracted text is parsed with, in Unicode LDML notation as used by MATLAB datetime and Java (e.g. 'yyyyMMdd', 'yyyy_MM_dd', 'HH_mm_ss', 'yyMMdd'). Readers support the tokens yyyy, yy, MM, dd, HH, mm and ss plus single-quoted literals; other tokens are not portable. A two-digit year (yy) is placed in 1969-2068, so 69 is 1969 and 68 is 2068.

extractorFunction.description: For method 'function': a registry key, not a language symbol. Each reader resolves it through its own extractor registry and calls the implementation with (fullPath, levelName, dataLocationIdentifier); the implementation returns a value of the field's dataType, or null when it cannot extract. A config that uses this method needs an implementation in every reader that consumes it.

entityLayoutLevel.description: Which component of the entity's path to read: the name of an entityLayout level (preferred) or its 0-based index. Null or omitted means the whole path of the entity relative to the root, '/'-separated. The level may be above the entity's own level (a session may read its date from a structural date folder) or, for an ancestor entity type that has no level of its own, below it (subject_id read from a session name).

filePattern.description: DRAFT, method 'sidecar': glob for the sidecar file inside the entity folder (e.g. '*_metadata.json').

contentPath.description: DRAFT, method 'sidecar': path to the value within the file (dot notation for JSON/YAML, column name for CSV, key name for key-value text).

fileFormat.description: DRAFT, method 'sidecar': format of the sidecar file.

normalize.description: Normalisation applied after extraction so that values converge across data locations. Important for identity fields.

normalizePattern.description: Argument for strip_prefix / strip_suffix: the literal prefix or suffix to remove (e.g. 'sub-').

entityRelationship.description: A semantic relationship between two entity types, independent of physical storage layout.

sourceEntity.description: Name of the source entity type (must match a name in entityTypes).

targetEntity.description: Name of the target entity type (must match a name in entityTypes).

isRequired.description: Whether every sourceEntity instance must have at least one related targetEntity instance.

spreadsheetSource.description: DRAFT: entity records read from a spreadsheet; each row is one record.

filePath.description: Path to the spreadsheet file (.xlsx, .csv, .tsv), relative to the config or absolute.

sheetName.description: Sheet to read; the first sheet when omitted.

headerRow.description: 1-based row number of the column headers.

columnMapping.description: Maps columns to global metadata definitions.

databaseSource.description: DRAFT: entity records read from a database table or view; each row is one record.

connectionRef.description: Identifier of an externally stored connection configuration. Connection details and credentials are never stored in the config.

columnMapping.description: Maps columns to global metadata definitions.

apiSource.description: DRAFT: entity records read from a remote API endpoint.

connectionRef.description: Identifier of an externally stored API configuration (base URL, authentication). Credentials are never stored in the config.

fieldMapping.description: Maps response fields to global metadata definitions.

field.description: Field name or dot-separated path in the response (e.g. 'subject.id').

metadataRef.description: Key in metadataDefinitions this field provides values for.

columnMappingEntry.description: DRAFT: maps one spreadsheet or database column to a global metadata definition.

column.description: Column header as it appears in the source.

metadataRef.description: Key in metadataDefinitions this column provides values for.
